VBO:0201289.summary: A spaniel cross used in British shooting, the Sprocker combines English Springer and Cocker ancestry. Gundog writer David Tomlinson describes both first crosses and later Sprocker matings, with wide variation in size and coat colour rather than one fixed appearance. A working pedigree does not make temperament predictable; even his own dog’s biddability is presented as luck rather than a general promise.
VBO:0201289.shortDescription: A Springer–Cocker cross used in shooting, with variable size and coat; a working pedigree is no temperament guarantee.
